According to the information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the records of the Company, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of Goods and Service Tax, Provident Fund, Income-Tax, or other statutory dues were in arrears as at 31 March 2025 for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.
